mifepristone.definition: n an abortion-inducing drug (trade name RU_486) developed in France; when taken during the first five weeks of pregnancy it blocks the action of progesterone so that the uterus sloughs off the embryo
mifepristone.translation: n. 米非司酮（一种堕胎药）

miff.translation:
n. 小争执, 愠怒
vt. 使恼怒
vi. 恼羞成怒

miffed.definition:
v cause to be annoyed
s aroused to impatience or anger
miffed.translation:
n. 稍有点恼火, 有点生气
v. 使恼怒, 恼羞成怒( miff的过去式和过去分词 )

miffing.translation: v. 使恼怒, 恼羞成怒( miff的现在分词 )

miffs.definition:
n a state of irritation or annoyance
v cause to be annoyed
miffs.translation: v. 使恼怒, 恼羞成怒( miff的第三人称单数 )

miffy.translation: a. 易生气的, 易发脾气的
